about.title: About Me
about.p1: I transform complex data into strategic decisions and develop applications that automate corporate routines. With a solid foundation in Mechanical Engineering and Systems Analysis, I work at the intersection of Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, and Web Development.
about.p2: My journey has combined a constant search for efficiency with a passion for technology. Today, I build end-to-end solutions: from extracting and processing data in industrial and corporate ecosystems using Python and SQL, to creating dynamic Power BI dashboards and developing modern digital products.
